speaker: spk_0
text: Thanks for joining Rizal. I'm Alex, I'll be leading the NovaPay integration for MegaMart. I know your team has been evaluating options for the past few months.

speaker: spk_0
text: Yes, thanks Alex. We've been on a local processor for years but the fraud tools are outdated and we need something that scales for our online expansion.

speaker: spk_0
text: Can you walk me through your current setup? How many stores, what's the monthly volume, and what does the online split look like?

speaker: spk_0
text: 60 stores across Peninsular Malaysia, about 8 million ringgit a month total. Online is growing fast, maybe 20 percent now. We're planning to launch in Singapore next year.

speaker: spk_0
text: That's solid. So roughly 1.8 million USD equivalent. NovaPay's unified gateway would consolidate your POS and e-commerce into one platform — one dashboard, one settlement file.

speaker: spk_0
text: That sounds good. But our main concern is currency. All our transactions are in ringgit. Can NovaPay handle MYR?

speaker: spk_0
text: Right now NovaPay settles in USD only. Multi-currency settlement is on the roadmap. For the interim, transactions would be processed in MYR at the terminal but settled in USD with an FX conversion.

speaker: spk_0
text: What's the FX markup on that conversion? Our current processor charges 2 percent on top of the mid-market rate.

speaker: spk_0
text: NovaPay's standard FX markup is 1.5 percent. At your volume we can negotiate that down to around 1 percent. That's competitive for the corridor.

speaker: spk_0
text: And Bank Negara requires all domestic transactions to be in ringgit. Is that going to be an issue?

speaker: spk_0
text: No issue. The customer-facing transaction is in MYR. The USD settlement is on the backend between NovaPay and your treasury. Bank Negara's requirement is about the consumer-facing price, which stays in ringgit.

speaker: spk_0
text: What about fraud? We've been getting hit on the online side. Lots of card testing attacks.

speaker: spk_0
text: NovaPay includes ShieldAI, their ML-based fraud engine trained on over 2 billion transactions. It assigns a risk score to every transaction in real time. Typically reduces fraud losses by about 68 percent.

speaker: spk_0
text: Is ShieldAI included or is it an add-on?

speaker: spk_0
text: Included on the Enterprise plan at no extra per-transaction charge. Your current processor probably charges per-screened transaction for their equivalent.

speaker: spk_0
text: They do, about 5 sen per transaction. It adds up. What about the integration timeline? We have 60 stores on Verifone terminals.

speaker: spk_0
text: NovaPay works with Verifone so that's a smooth transition. For a full rollout — terminals plus e-commerce — we typically see four to six weeks. Migration support is included on Enterprise.

speaker: spk_0
text: And PCI compliance? Our last audit was painful.

speaker: spk_0
text: NovaPay is PCI DSS Level 1 certified and SOC 2 Type II. If you use the drop-in SDK, you stay at SAQ-A — a 20-question self-assessment instead of a full audit.

speaker: spk_0
text: That would save us a lot. What about the Singapore expansion? Would the same integration work there?

speaker: spk_0
text: Yes, same platform. Singapore has no currency restrictions so you can accept SGD and settle in USD. The Brunei dollar is pegged to SGD so that's straightforward too if you ever expand there.

speaker: spk_0
text: All right, I think we have a good picture. Can you put together a formal proposal with pricing in ringgit terms?

speaker: spk_0
text: Absolutely. I'll have the proposal with MYR-equivalent pricing, projected savings, and a phased rollout plan to you by Friday. Let's schedule a follow-up next week.

speaker: spk_0
text: Sounds good. Our CTO Amir will want to join for the technical review.

speaker: spk_0
text: Looking forward to it. Talk next week Rizal.
